problems.name: Large Knowledge Base Context Overload
problems.description: AI agents must read many files to understand a large knowledge base, exceeding context windows and wasting tokens.
problems.proposed_solution: Lens-dependent multiscale graph compression via semantic zoom

problems.name: Token Waste in Retrieval
problems.description: Retrieved documents contain more irrelevant information than relevant, wasting tokens.

problems.name: Shallow Retrieval Without Learning
problems.description: Traditional RAG retrieves by similarity but does not strengthen relationships or learn from retrieval success.
problems.proposed_solution: Dynamic RAG with graph updates from feedback

problems.name: Semantic Relationships Beyond Similarity
problems.description: Vector similarity does not represent causation, opposition, support, or dependency.
problems.proposed_solution: Typed edges with numeric forces, modified by lenses

problems.name: One-Size-Fits-All Retrieval
problems.description: Different questions require different views of the same knowledge, but most systems apply a single ranking strategy.
problems.proposed_solution: Semantic lenses that modify graph emphasis per query

problems.name: AI-Generated Text Without Provenance
problems.description: Generated explanations cannot be traced back to specific knowledge structures.
problems.proposed_solution: Provenance metadata linking output to graph nodes and edges

problems.name: Disconnected Specifications and Code
problems.description: Natural-language specifications and executable code drift apart.
problems.proposed_solution: Interlocked translation through semantic graph intermediary

problems.name: Agent Misunderstanding
problems.description: AI agents may fail to recognize when they have misunderstood an instruction.
problems.proposed_solution: Gap detection and clarification question generation

problems.name: Tool Failures Discarded
problems.description: Tool failures are discarded as errors rather than incorporated into persistent reasoning state.
problems.proposed_solution: Failures recorded as semantic constraints in the graph

problems.name: Knowledge Graph Complexity
problems.description: Knowledge graphs become complex and hard to reason over as they grow.
problems.proposed_solution: Lens-dependent graph coarsening via semantic zoom

problems.name: Knowledge Graph Ambiguity
problems.description: Link count is mistaken for importance. Generic nodes dominate rankings.

problems.name: Multiple Perspectives on Knowledge
problems.description: Different questions require different semantic views over the same knowledge.
problems.proposed_solution: Explicit semantic lenses that modify graph emphasis
